about: Pre-registered landmark (L) dev set for SPARK Task 1, written 2026-10-22 by AI agents for MV2 of Munim, Inc. before any lookup. Titles, years, journals and first authors are recalled and are only hints: dev_sets.py keeps an item only if PubMed returns a near-identical title. 'contested' marks priority claims that other papers share; they are left out of the headline score. 'control' marks pre-1959 papers that should fall outside the SPARK window. CC BY 4.0.
